description:
~930 lines covering text editing, dropdown, IME composition, paste,
slash-commands, history. d06.7 covers the cursor stamping; this
ticket covers everything else: Input.render returning a VRow with
prompt + text + VCursor + suffix; the dropdown becomes a separate
VFlow rendered as a sibling (not via the bespoke `render_dropdown/2`
escape); state moves into hook cells.

Acceptance: every existing input_test.exs assertion stays green;
keystroke smoke test in tmux confirms IME composition, paste, and
dropdown navigation are unchanged.
title: Convert Input component (full surface beyond cursor)
